title: AUDIT-10 finding record
description: One line of plans/audit10/state/findings.jsonl. Validate every append with `node _harness/audit10-findings.js` — it checks the schema, rejects duplicate ids, and regenerates plans/audit10/state/FINDINGS.md (the human view: URL, description, severity, screenshot).

id.description: A10-001, A10-002, ... — allocate max_existing + 1; never reuse

severity_rationale.description: required for A/B; who is hurt and how

url.description: the URL it was found on, exactly as visitable (path + query)

what_it_does_to_a_real_person.description: one or two concrete sentences about Rick or a buyer

measurement.description: the number/string that proves it — px, ratio, count, exact text. THE durable evidence; screenshots are gitignored and die with the container

current_state_screenshot.description: the pass-0 capture the issue was first seen in, if any

probe.description: _harness/audit10-*.js file that reproduces it, if one was written

reproduce.description: exact steps from a fresh browser context

where.description: file:line if traced to source; omit rather than guess

instances.description: for batched D-nits: every occurrence (url :: exact string/value)

out_of_pass.description: true when found outside the recording pass's subject

dedupe_note.description: why this is not the same as an earlier A10-*/known issue, when adjacency exists
